rate.policyNote: The corpus concurrentRate value is a synthetic fixture input. The selected reference (a7d37f1 ConcurrentRateLimiter.kt) admits at most N starts per T-millisecond window with no fetchEnd, so 1/2000 opens a window on the first start and rolls it on each following start. No product policy is changed and no 150ms heuristic exists.

plain.requirement: The declared helper batch runs on a plain T interval. A bounded observer samples the source's first actual record and the final record proves an advance of at least T; operation and replay receipt times are producer-local causal evidence, not exact admission timestamps. The first response remains unsent when the second request arrives, and the existing cohort releases by completing, never by its own window. No minimum replay arrival gap or admission-to-receipt latency bound is assumed.
plain.selectionNote: The declared helper batch is the existing cohort gate; no second hold, timer substitute or response-delay feature is introduced. A stage page walk cannot carry this relation because the product's declared-page walk is serial by design.

classification.statusRetryImpossible: no response is ever written, so the OkHttpUtils.kt:29-43 source-status retry cannot occur

cancellation.entry: kotlinx.coroutines.JobKt.Job(null) + CoroutineContext.plus + the two-argument kotlinx.coroutines.BuildersKt.runBlocking + Job.cancel

negative.requirement: validate and hash the immutable corpus first, drop one declared ordinary helper response at load time only, let the request reach replay, require exactly the intended unmatched terminal named here, and never promote the report

sourceDerivedNotes.ajaxAllConcurrency: JsExtensions.kt:139-153 maps with AppConfig.threadCount (default 32 at a7d37f1).
sourceDerivedNotes.productAjaxAllWidthStatus: source-derived, not observed by the native producer; the product consumer records its own real peak
sourceDerivedNotes.tocPagination: BookChapterList.kt:65-115 batches only the declared next URLs after the ordered initial page.
sourceDerivedNotes.contentPagination: BookContent.kt:110-135 batches only the declared next URLs after the first page.
sourceDerivedNotes.retry: OkHttpUtils.kt:29-45 returns the first successful or 3xx response and otherwise the last one, so retry=2 is 1 attempt on 2xx/3xx and 3 on 4xx/5xx.
sourceDerivedNotes.headerMapScriptArity: The pinned host probe dispatches source.getHeaderMap(false) on a source-signature carrier and rejects the zero-argument call; that is host carrier provenance, not Android execution. The collector measures the actual Android script outcomes for all three arities.
sourceDerivedNotes.scriptProbe: The scriptProbe helper action evaluates one fixture-authored script through the real AnalyzeUrl.evalJS/source binding (frozen) and the product's own InProcessSourceScriptRuntime; its result is the script's JSON projection, compared before any diagnostic conversion.
sourceDerivedNotes.freshCarrier: A details step declared carrier=fresh opens a genuinely new product BookSourcePipeline over the same source object/key and the identical stored search hit; the frozen details stage constructs its own AnalyzeUrl per stage call for the same retained book. The source-authored URL-option js reads and increments one O-source counter, so the two actual invocations supply the distinct /1 and /2 selectors without a transport rewrite. The declaration is validated at the corpus boundary and the actual hit reference, pipeline/transport/source/host-state identities, counter and request facts are in the observation value/evidence.
sourceDerivedNotes.urlOptionJs: The URL-option rows keep the selected absolute pre-option address and the original raw option tail; no side rebases or manufactures a transformed URL. The product's same-analysis HTML _extracted path does not run the option js (a measured omission), while a fresh analysis and the JSON adapter do.

changesSinceHistoricalCorpus.AnalyzeUrl: the selected entry has a 16-parameter primary constructor (infoMap, extraParams) and new URL-option timeout/followRedirects/dnsIp/bodyJs handling; the collector resolves the 16-parameter constructor by declared signature and records it.
changesSinceHistoricalCorpus.getChapterListAwait: the selected entry takes isFromBookInfo (WebBook.kt:297-302); the collector resolves the widest accepted arity, passes false and records the resolved signature.
changesSinceHistoricalCorpus.threadCount: the selected default is 32; the capture records the actual AppConfig.getThreadCount() read.
changesSinceHistoricalCorpus.rate: ConcurrentRecord carries time/accessLimit/interval/frequency and the limiter has no fetchEnd; the selected capture records the declared record fields and window schedule, keeping accessLimit/interval as provenance.

hostInitialization.invocation: on an unattached io.legado.app.App instance, after the scratch binding and its context routing are verified; App.onCreate, App.attachBaseContext and every background job stay unrun
